title: ClearPath Tier Deposit Shares for Endpoint Order Approvals
content:
The endpoint deposit share, the percentage at which the deposit on the approval of a Hardware Procurement Standard Endpoint Order or Staged Endpoint Order quote is taken, is **10.0 percent** for a client whose active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement is on the ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise tier, **20.0 percent** for a client whose active ClearPath agreement is on the ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional tier, and the order type's deposit percentage, 25 percent for both endpoint order types, for every other client.

| Client's ClearPath position on the approval day | Endpoint deposit share |
|---|---|
| Active agreement, ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise | 10.0 percent |
| Active agreement, ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional | 20.0 percent |
| Active agreement, ClearPath Monitor or ClearPath Essentials | 25 percent |
| Agreement in any other status, or no agreement | 25 percent |

The tier and status are read from the client's ClearPath agreement record. A ClearPath Premier agreement that has been cancelled is not an active agreement and gives the 25 percent share.

### Illustration (hypothetical figures)

On a quote total of 8000.00, a share of 10.0 percent is 800.00, 20.0 percent is 1600.00 and 25 percent is 2000.00.
